payload.title: [multi-region-7] MemoryRegionProxy.onProxiedWrite returns a stale-closure unsubscribe that can detach the CURREN...
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING multi-region-7 (low/correctness, confidence=high, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/cluster/region-router.ts
LINES: 315-322

WHAT: onProxiedWrite detaches any prior handler, attaches the new one, and returns an unsubscribe closure that calls `this.#detach?.()`. The returned closure captures `this`, not the specific detach it installed. If onProxiedWrite is called twice (h1 then h2), calling the FIRST returned unsubscribe later runs `this.#detach?.()` which now points at h2's detach — so unsubscribing h1 (already replaced) actually tears down h2, the live handler. The home region then silently stops receiving proxied writes.

IMPACT: A caller that re-registers the home applier and later disposes the old subscription can accidentally detach the active applier, dropping all proxied (non-home → home) writes for that region with no error. Limited blast radius because the intended usage is a single long-lived home handler, but it is a latent footgun.

SUGGESTED FIX: Capture the specific detach in the returned closure: `const detach = this.#fabric.attach(...); this.#detach = detach; return () => { detach(); if (this.#detach === detach) this.#detach = undefined; };`
